description: This Java class defines enumeration mappings and utility methods for various savings account related enums in the Apache Fineract project. It provides methods to convert integer or enum values into external data representations, fetch specific enum options, and gather related symbols for the savings account module.

classes.name: SavingsEnumerations
classes.description: A utility class providing mappings and data conversions for various savings account enumerations in the Fineract system.

methods.name: savingEnumueration
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData object for a given string typeName and id, mapping internal enum representations to external data formats.

methods.name: lockinPeriodFrequencyType
methods.description: Maps an integer or enum type to an EnumOptionData representing the lock-in period frequency type.

methods.name: transactionType
methods.description: Converts a transaction type ID or enum to its external representation as SavingsAccountTransactionEnumData.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Converts an account status enum or integer to its external SavingsAccountStatusEnumData.

methods.name: subStatus
methods.description: Converts a sub-status enum or integer to its external SavingsAccountSubStatusEnumData.

methods.name: interestPostingPeriodType
methods.description: Returns the interest posting period type as EnumOptionData based on an integer or enum value.

methods.name: compoundingInterestPeriodType
methods.description: Returns the compounding interest period type as EnumOptionData based on an integer or enum value.

methods.name: interestCalculationType
methods.description: Returns the interest calculation type as EnumOptionData based on an integer or enum value.

methods.name: interestCalculationDaysInYearType
methods.description: Returns the days-in-year type for interest calculation as EnumOptionData.

methods.name: withdrawalFeeType
methods.description: Returns the withdrawal fee type as EnumOptionData based on an integer or enum.

methods.name: preClosurePenaltyInterestOnType
methods.description: Maps pre-closure penalty interest types to EnumOptionData representations.

methods.name: recurringDepositType
methods.description: Maps recurring deposit types to EnumOptionData.

methods.name: recurringDepositFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns the recurring deposit frequency type as EnumOptionData based on an enum or integer.

methods.name: depositType
methods.description: Returns deposit account type as EnumOptionData based on an enum or integer.

methods.name: depositPeriodFrequency
methods.description: Maps deposit period frequency to EnumOptionData.

methods.name: depositAccountOnClosureType
methods.description: Returns the deposit account closure type as EnumOptionData based on an enum or integer.

methods.name: onHoldTransactionType
methods.description: Returns the on-hold transaction type as EnumOptionData based on an enum or integer.
